name: Actuator After Hours
description: A robotics lab’s actuator console is still answering on the course network after the night shift. Scan the lab network at 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. Find the console, obtain access, and recover its protected record.

tasks.name: Recover the actuator record
tasks.description: The robotics lab’s actuator console is reachable on the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24 (challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199), find the console, and recover the protected record.
hints: Pay attention to the information the console gives before you have an account.
Inspect the service greeting for maintenance access details, then use the service’s normal login flow.
Connect with the discovered account and password, then retrieve the protected record from its account area.
